name: @aravhawk/cc-switch
description: Profile manager for Claude Code: switch between Anthropic, open-model providers, gateways and local models

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.release:patch: pnpm version patch && git push --follow-tags && gh release create "$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)" --generate-notes
scripts.release:minor: pnpm version minor && git push --follow-tags && gh release create "$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)" --generate-notes
scripts.release:major: pnpm version major && git push --follow-tags && gh release create "$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)" --generate-notes

author: Arav
